title: AI Project Manager
description:
AI Project Manager | London (On-site) | Permanent | Up to £85,000 + bonus + pension

We’re recruiting for an AI Project Manager to define and lead our client’s AI vision. You’ll shape how AI tools are adopted across the business, launch new AI-augmented initiatives from scratch, and turn early experiments into reliable, repeatable workflows. It’s hands-on, with real ownership: you set the direction, then deliver against it.

What you’ll do
  • Define and own the AI vision and roadmap, aligned to business priorities
  • Design, deliver and embed AI-augmented workflows across teams
  • Evaluate, introduce and champion AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot
  • Run new AI projects from concept through to adoption
  • Set guardrails for responsible, secure and compliant AI use
  • Measure impact and report on productivity gains and adoption
  • Train and support colleagues so AI tooling is used confidently
  • Work with stakeholders at every level, technical and non-technical

What you’ll bring
  • 12+ months’ experience delivering AI-augmented workflows in a live environment
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Claude and Copilot
  • A proven record of launching projects and driving adoption
  • Strong organisation and flexibility with shifting priorities
  • Clear communication, translating AI capability into business value
  • Background in a small firm or a larger corporate; both are welcome

Nice to have
  • Cybersecurity or information security experience
  • Understanding of data protection, governance and AI risk
  • Experience building a function or strategy from scratch
  • Change management or training experience

What’s on offer
  • The chance to set the AI direction for the organisation
  • Salary up to £85,000
  • Bonus and a great pension
  • On-site in London

Interested? Message me or apply directly. Happy to share more detail on the role.
